content.title: Application resume
content.subtitle: A resume for a job and one for an application are a little different.

steps.title: Keep it short
steps.detail: If it's too long, the important things get lost. Keep only what relates to the course.

steps.title: Education at the top
steps.detail: Degree, college and score first. Then projects and experience.

steps.title: Write project results
steps.detail: What you built, which tools you used and what the result was. Short, simple lines.

steps.title: Match it to the course
steps.detail: Applying for Data Science? Show your data projects first.

steps.title: Simple format
steps.detail: One font, clear headings, send it as a PDF. No fancy design needed.

content.saveLine: it will help before you apply.

caption:
Making a resume for your application? Follow these 5 steps 👇

1. Keep it short
2. Education at the top
3. Write project results
4. Match it to the course
5. Simple format
